name: Fresh milk
summary: Sữa tươi is fresh milk. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names it with yogurt and milk cake. The Tourism Information Technology Center names the dairy farm as a place where visitors make dairy products. Two visit write-ups disagree on the gate. Check on arrival.
origin: The Moc Chau dairy farm. The national authority’s attractions feature, and the Tourism Information Technology Center.
howToEat: Drink it cold or as the morning cup in the farm town. A pour size was not printed.
Dat Viet Tour prints a 20,000 VND gate and Kenh Homestay prints 10,000 VND. Both print 08:00–18:00. Neither is the dairy company’s notice. Check on arrival.
where: The dairy farm in the farm town. The two write-ups both print 168 Hoàng Quốc Việt and disagree on the gate. Those addresses are not merged into one chosen fee.
seoDescription: Sữa tươi is fresh milk named for Moc Chau. Two visit write-ups print 20,000 VND and 10,000 VND. Check on arrival.
